stem:
The diagram shows cross-sections of two transparent curved glass pieces, P and Q. Padma measures thickness from the middle to the edges of each piece.

Which classification is correct?

options.text: P is a convex lens and Q is a concave lens.
P is a concave lens and Q is a convex lens.
Both are convex lenses because both outlines look curved.
P is a convex lens because it is made of glass.

teacher.key_rationale: A convex lens is thicker in the middle than at the edges (P). A concave lens is thicker at the edges than in the middle (Q). Curved outline or glass alone does not decide the type.
teacher.figure_note: Rewrote plane-mirror ray figure into two lens cross-sections matching the thickness hinge.
